name: web-tester
description: Automates web tests and accessibility checks: writes Playwright or RobotFramework scenarios with page objects, scans a page or a local HTML file with axe-core, classifies an axe-core results JSON file and gives a pass or fail verdict on violations by impact (critical, serious, moderate, minor) against a fail-on threshold, checks a page against a design system or spec, and runs regression or visual-diff passes. Use when writing or fixing an end-to-end browser test, running an axe scan of a rendered page, reading an axe results file exported by CI, turning a user journey into an executable scenario, or running a smoke or regression pass on staging. Not for unit or integration tests (tester), manual keyboard and ARIA review (accessibility-auditor agent), static HTML accessibility review or HTML and CSS authoring (frontend) or CI workflow files (github-actions).

findings.excerpt: - **GitHub Actions wiring**: headless Chromium on `ubuntu-latest`, install browsers with `npx playwright install --with-deps chromium`, upload `playwright-repor
- `npx playwright` (Node projects) or `python -m playwright` (Python projects) for direct CLI use.
